taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: MCP HTTP transport revision, origin and request/stream authority binding
controls.source_trace: Select the implemented HTTP transport profile, then follow validated request identity and transport metadata into tool execution and the correct response stream. Apply session ownership only to a session-bearing legacy profile.
controls.implementation_branch: Separate legacy session-bearing Streamable HTTP from the stateless 2026-07-28 revision before interpreting transport state. A session identifier is never a substitute for request authentication; a modern implementation need not create one. Validate a present Origin independently from legitimate nonbrowser absence and resolve mirrored metadata under the applicable profile.
controls.operational_method: Select the implemented protocol revision before testing. Legacy Streamable HTTP revisions 2025-03-26 through 2025-11-25 can have protocol sessions; review authenticated session ownership and stream routing there. Revision2026-07-28 removes protocol sessions and the standalone GET stream: do not demand a session or treat an ignored Mcp-Session-Id as bypass. For that profile compare MCP-Protocol-Version and mirrored method/name/annotated-parameter headers with body metadata and request fields under its validation rules. Each request still needs applicable authentication and present-Origin validation; absent Origin can be a legitimate non-browser case.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned mock for the selected profile: compare authorized request, absent-Origin authenticated nonbrowser request and invalid present Origin. For legacy sessions compare wrong-owner routing; for 2026-07-28 compare mirrored-header/body mismatch and per-request stream ownership.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An ignored legacy session header on a stateless modern profile, an authenticated nonbrowser request without Origin or absence of standalone GET streams is not itself a bypass; require a violated applicable authority rule.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce the selected revision request/origin/identity and stream binding rules, then retest legitimate requests and the specific forbidden context without imposing legacy session mechanics on the modern profile.
